caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object resembling a utensil or tool against a plain, light beige background. The object is vertically oriented and consists of a long, narrow handle at the top that gradually widens downward into a wider, fan-shaped blade or head. The handle is cylindrical, silver-gray in color, and has a circular hole near the top for possible hanging. The head of the object is also silver-gray, with a slightly reflective sheen indicating a metallic surface. It features a decorative arch made of two curved, closely-spaced lines with short diagonal marks between them, resembling a laurel wreath or a stylized arc. The bottom edge of the head has a row of evenly spaced, short, rounded protrusions that give a comb-like appearance. A few white highlights at the base suggest reflective properties of the surface. The composition is centered, with the object placed in the middle of the frame, and no other objects are present.
title: Iron Carpet Stretcher
